headline: Expanse Grinds On; Kuura Strand Quiets; Nevish Line Still Pressed
war_summary: The great grinder at Weathered Expanse shows no sign of cooling. Forty-six actions were logged there in the past day, eleven of them within six hours and two within the last two, the latest at 02:46; the day's bill stands at 7,671 Colonial and 8,668 Warden casualties. The ground now reads two Warden works, four Colonial and three unclaimed, one Colonial position having gone unclaimed since the previous edition. Frostmarch, Crow's Nest and Wightwalk bear the brunt. Kuura Strand has gone quieter still: three actions in two hours and nine in six, against thirty-one for the day, with the day's cost at 3,001 Colonial and 2,799 Warden; its lines now stand at six Colonial works and no Warden holdout. On the Nevish Line the five-to-three Warden advantage holds, with twenty-three actions across the day and heavy recent casualties, 799 Colonial and 742 Warden in two hours, Tomb Father busiest. Marban Hollow is unchanged at four Warden, three Colonial and one unclaimed, thirteen actions in six hours around Checkpoint Bua. Stlican Shelf logged two actions in the past two hours, while Linn Mercy bleeds heavily though no works have changed hands in six hours. Callahan's Passage and Dead Lands remain costly but quiet.
